title: Large Language Models Can Follow Instructions, But Not Many at Once: Phase Transitions in Compositional Constraint Satisfaction
abstract: arXiv:2608.12426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in settings that require simultaneous adherence to multiple explicit constraints - reasoning structure, safety boundaries, output schemas. Individual constraints are handled proficiently, but the compositional regime, where many must hold jointly, remains poorly characterized: how rapidly does performance degrade, what governs the degradation, and can the collapse be mitigated? We introduce Constraint Saturation Evaluation (CSE), a procedurally generated benchmark that systematically varies the number of simultaneous constraints (k), with every constraint scored by a deterministic, rule-based verifier and zero LLM-judge involvement: 15 models, 36 constraint types, 369,753 checks at k=1-12. Three findings emerge. First, per-constraint pass rate decays gradually and predictably, while the chance of satisfying all k constraints collapses - a model passing individual constraints at ~41% at k=8

translated_title: 大型语言模型能遵循指令，但无法同时处理过多指令：组合约束满足中的相变现象
translated_abstract: 摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地被部署在需要同时遵循多个显式约束的环境中——推理结构、安全边界、输出模式。单个约束能被熟练处理，但组合场景（即多个约束必须同时满足）仍缺乏充分描述：性能退化有多快，什么因素控制退化，以及这种崩溃能否被缓解？我们引入了约束饱和评估（CSE），这是一个程序生成的基准，系统性地改变同时约束的数量（k），每个约束由确定性、基于规则的验证器评分，且不涉及LLM评判：涵盖15个模型、36种约束类型，在k=1-12范围内进行了369,753次检查。研究发现了三个要点。首先，单约束通过率逐渐且可预测地下降，而同时满足所有k个约束的概率则急剧崩溃——在k=8时，单个约束通过率约为41%的模型，其整体成功概率几乎为零。其次，退化遵循清晰的相变模式，存在一个临界约束数量，超过该数量后性能急剧下降。第三，模型规模与指令遵循能力之间存在正相关，但无法完全弥补组合约束带来的挑战。
tldr: 该论文引入约束饱和评估（CSE）基准，揭示了大型语言模型在同时处理多个约束时性能呈相变式崩溃，而非渐进退化，且模型规模无法完全弥补这一局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Constraint Saturation Evaluation (CSE) benchmark, revealing that large language models exhibit phase-transition-like collapse in performance when handling multiple simultaneous constraints, rather than gradual degradation, and model scale cannot fully compensate for this limitation.
